microtheory.name: nutrition
microtheory.definition: Nutrition — nutrients, dietary patterns, metabolism, deficiency, food + health relationships. Macronutrients (carbohydrate, protein, lipid), micronutrients (vitamins, minerals), water. Energy balance, weight regulation, nutrition-related disease. Substrate analogue: applied biochemistry of biological-system fueling and material supply.

concepts.name: nutrient
concepts.definition: Substance the body needs from food. Essential (must be obtained externally) vs non-essential (body synthesises).

concepts.name: macronutrient
concepts.definition: Required in large amounts. Carbohydrate (4 kcal/g), protein (4 kcal/g), fat (9 kcal/g), alcohol (7 kcal/g).

concepts.name: micronutrient
concepts.definition: Required in small amounts. Vitamins + minerals + trace elements.

concepts.name: kilocalorie
concepts.definition: kcal. Energy unit. Heat to raise 1 kg water 1°C. ~2000 kcal/day adult baseline.

concepts.name: carbohydrate
concepts.definition: Sugars + starches + fiber. Simple (mono/disaccharides) + complex (polysaccharides). Primary fuel.

concepts.name: glucose
concepts.definition: Simple sugar. Body's primary energy substrate. Blood glucose regulated tightly (insulin + glucagon).

concepts.name: glycemic_index
concepts.definition: Blood glucose response to food relative to reference. High GI → rapid spike; low GI → gradual.

concepts.name: dietary_fiber
concepts.definition: Indigestible plant material. Soluble (oats, legumes) + insoluble (whole grain). Glucose modulation + satiety + microbiome.

concepts.name: protein
concepts.definition: Amino acid polymer. Structural + enzymatic + signalling. 9 essential amino acids must be obtained.

concepts.name: amino_acid
concepts.definition: Building block of proteins. 20 standard. Essential: histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine.

concepts.name: complete_protein
concepts.definition: Contains all essential amino acids in adequate proportions. Animal sources + soy + quinoa.

concepts.name: nitrogen_balance
concepts.definition: Intake vs excretion. Positive = growth/anabolism; negative = breakdown/catabolism.

concepts.name: lipid
concepts.definition: Fats + oils. Triglycerides primary dietary form. Energy storage, membrane structure, signalling.

concepts.name: fatty_acid
concepts.definition: Lipid building block. Saturated vs unsaturated (mono/poly). Trans = isomer from processing.

concepts.name: omega_3_fatty_acid
concepts.definition: Essential PUFA. EPA + DHA from fish oil; ALA from flax. Anti-inflammatory.

concepts.name: saturated_fat
concepts.definition: No double bonds. Solid at room temp. Butter, meat. Excess raises LDL cholesterol.

concepts.name: trans_fat
concepts.definition: Industrial hydrogenation produces. Raises LDL, lowers HDL. Banned/restricted in many countries.

concepts.name: cholesterol
concepts.definition: Sterol. Membrane + bile acid + steroid hormone precursor. LDL (bad) + HDL (good) lipoproteins transport.

concepts.name: vitamin
concepts.definition: Organic micronutrient. Cofactor in enzyme reactions. Water-soluble (B, C) or fat-soluble (A, D, E, K).

concepts.name: vitamin_d
concepts.definition: Synthesised in skin from UV. Bone health + immune function. Deficiency widespread in high latitudes.

concepts.name: vitamin_b12
concepts.definition: Cobalamin. Animal-source only. Deficiency causes pernicious anemia + neuropathy. Vegan supplementation needed.

concepts.name: mineral_nutrient
concepts.definition: Inorganic. Major (Ca, P, K, Na, Mg) + trace (Fe, Zn, Cu, Mn, I, Se).

concepts.name: iron_nutrition
concepts.definition: Heme (animal, well-absorbed) + non-heme (plant). Deficiency = most common worldwide. Women + children at higher risk.

concepts.name: energy_balance
concepts.definition: Intake = expenditure + storage. Positive → weight gain; negative → loss. First law of thermodynamics.

concepts.name: basal_metabolic_rate
concepts.definition: BMR. Energy at rest. Largest component of expenditure. Mass + age + sex dependent.

concepts.name: physical_activity_energy
concepts.definition: Exercise-induced expenditure. NEAT (non-exercise activity) significant component.

concepts.name: thermogenesis
concepts.definition: Heat production. Diet-induced (TEF ~10% intake) + cold-induced. Brown fat.

concepts.name: macronutrient_distribution
concepts.definition: Common ranges: carb 45-65%, fat 20-35%, protein 10-35%. Wide latitude for health.

concepts.name: mediterranean_diet
concepts.definition: Plant-forward + olive oil + fish + moderate wine. Strong cardiovascular + longevity evidence (PREDIMED).

concepts.name: blue_zones_diet
concepts.definition: Buettner. Longest-living populations: plant-heavy, low meat, moderate alcohol, community + purpose.

concepts.name: ketogenic_diet
concepts.definition: Very low carb. Body switches to ketones for fuel. Epilepsy treatment + some weight loss + glycemic effects.

concepts.name: obesity
concepts.definition: Excess adiposity (BMI > 30). Multifactorial: genes, environment, behavior. Comorbidity for many diseases.

concepts.name: type_2_diabetes
concepts.definition: Insulin resistance. Hyperglycemia. Largely lifestyle-related. Major + growing.

concepts.name: malnutrition
concepts.definition: Either undernutrition (caloric/protein/micronutrient) or overnutrition. Both leading causes of disability.

concepts.name: kwashiorkor_marasmus
concepts.definition: Severe protein deficiency vs total caloric deficiency. Childhood developing-world disease.

concepts.name: microbiome_gut_nutrition
concepts.definition: Trillions of microbes. Affect digestion, immunity, mood. Diet shapes composition. Substrate analogue: substrate's symbiont-substrate dependence.

rules.name: energy_balance_determines_weight
rules.head: Jabberwock examines weight change
rules.body: intake - expenditure = storage change. First law. Weight loss requires sustained energy deficit. Different macros may affect satiety + metabolism differently.

rules.name: essential_nutrients_must_be_supplied
rules.head: Jabberwock plans diet
rules.body: 9 essential amino acids + 2 essential fatty acids + vitamins + minerals not synthesised must be obtained. Deficiency → disease. Plant-only diets need B12 + may need iron + omega-3.

rules.name: diet_quality_dominates_macronutrient_ratio
rules.head: Jabberwock optimises diet for health
rules.body: food quality (whole vs processed) matters more than precise macro ratio. Mediterranean + Blue Zones evidence-strongest.

rules.name: deficiency_disease_specific_to_nutrient
rules.head: Jabberwock diagnoses nutritional deficiency
rules.body: each essential nutrient has characteristic deficiency syndrome: scurvy (C), pellagra (niacin), beriberi (B1), rickets (D).

rules.name: microbiome_mediates_diet_health_link
rules.head: Jabberwock investigates diet-disease mechanisms
rules.body: gut microbes ferment fiber → SCFAs, modulate immunity, produce neuroactive compounds. Diet shapes microbiome over days-weeks.
